caption:
An agent's tools (run shell commands, edit files, call APIs) are real actions on your machine or your accounts.

Good habits:
Allow read-only commands freely. Read anything that deletes, pushes, or sends data.
Run agents inside the project folder, not your home directory.
Use git, so every file change can be undone.
Never paste secrets into the chat.

This idea is called least privilege: give a tool only the access its task needs.

Source: OWASP, principle of least privilege.

altText:
Why do AI coding agents keep asking "Allow this command?"

Because an agent that can run
rm -rf build/
can also run
rm -rf ~/

The permission prompt is your last review step. Read it.
